items.headline:
What a reaction to the US CPI data just now.

Stocks and gold were crushed at 8:30 AM ET only to entirely erase their decline and turn positive 20 minutes later.

The 10Y Note Yield surged to a high of 4.99% before reversing and is now RED on the day.

This is a nervous market.

items.headline:
US DATA: RECORD CELL PHONE PRICE JUMP BOOSTS CORE CPI

August inflation data carried a hawkish signal as wireless phone service prices surged 5.9% — the largest increase on record.

The jump alone added around 0.08 percentage points to core CPI and will also feed into core PCE.

items.headline:
CPI SET TO DECIDE NEXT WEEK’S FED HIKE

Markets currently price a 61% chance of a 25-bp Fed hike on September 16, versus 39% for a hold, according to Kalshi.

With consensus expecting 0.2% core and 0.4% headline CPI M/M, Friday’s inflation print could sharply swing those odds.
